subject.title: fix(matrix): render message history and collapse streamed edits

question: Which of the two open Matrix PRs should be retained as the canonical fix for the blank history/pins tables and streamed replacement collapse?
rationale: Both branches target the same linked bug and substantially overlapping plugin surfaces, while this PR has a protected maintainer label; selecting one implementation requires maintainer judgment about the preferred replacement semantics and proof package.

options.title: Retain the proof-backed earlier PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99057 as the canonical candidate because it already carries proof-sufficient review state and live Matrix output in its body.

options.title: Adopt this newer implementation
options.body: Keep this PR only after maintainers compare its additional replacement cases against the earlier branch and accept its structured-result semantics.

options.title: Consolidate before merge
options.body: Ask for one rebased, narrowly scoped PR that incorporates the selected behavior and closes the other implementation candidate.

recommendation.title: Retain the proof-backed earlier PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99057 as the canonical candidate because it already carries proof-sufficient review state and live Matrix output in its body.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked implementation candidate and original behavior report, so they are the clearest technical routing contact among the available evidence.
